public
公共
Which public space would you like your town to improve?
I would improve the public seating near the station. Shade and accessible paths would make it useful to more people.
我想改善車站附近的公共座椅。增加遮蔭和無障礙動線，就能讓更多人使用。
government
政府
What information should a government provide when changing a local service?
The government should explain what changes, when it happens, and who is affected. People also need a clear way to ask questions.
政府應該說明改了什麼、何時改，以及影響哪些人。也要讓大家知道有問題能問誰。
policy
政策
How would you judge whether a new recycling policy was working?
I would look at results before and after the policy began. I would also ask whether residents found the instructions practical.
我會比較政策實施前後的成果。也問問居民，這些做法在生活中方不方便。
law
法律
You hear a claim about a new law. How would you check it?
I would look for the official text of the law or a reliable explanation. A shared message alone would not be enough.
我會查法律的正式內容，或可靠的說明。只看轉傳訊息，還不足以確認。
rule
規則
What makes a school rule easier for students to accept?
A rule is easier to accept when its purpose is clear. People should understand the problem it addresses, not just face a warning.
規則的目的清楚，大家比較能接受。要知道它解決什麼問題，不只是看到一張警告。
freedom
自由
How should people balance freedom with consideration for neighbours?
Freedom to enjoy my home does not mean ignoring nearby residents. I can play music while keeping the volume reasonable at night.
在家享受自由，不代表不用顧慮鄰居。我可以聽音樂，但晚上會把音量調低。
election
選舉
What would you compare before making a choice in a local election?
Before an election, I would compare candidates' plans for local problems. I would check whether their promises included realistic steps.
選舉前，我會比較候選人解決地方問題的計畫。也看看承諾裡，有沒有實際可行的步驟。
vote
投票
What could help people who find it difficult to vote?
Clear information about where and how to vote would help. Accessible locations would also matter for people with limited mobility.
清楚說明去哪裡、怎麼投票，會有幫助。對行動不便的人，地點是否方便抵達也很重要。
citizen
市民
How can a citizen contribute to a town without holding an official role?
A citizen can report problems and join local discussions. Consistent participation in small matters can improve everyday services.
市民可以通報問題，也參加地方討論。持續關心小事，同樣能改善日常服務。
volunteer
志工
What would you ask before agreeing to volunteer at an event?
I would ask what a volunteer was expected to do and for how long. Clear instructions would help me offer useful support.
答應當志工前，我會問清楚工作內容和時間。有明確說明，才知道怎麼幫得上忙。
charity
慈善團體
How would you choose a charity to support?
I would choose a charity that explains its work and spending clearly. I would also check whether its activities address the need it describes.
我會選能清楚說明工作和支出的慈善團體。也確認它的活動，是否真正在回應所說的需要。
donate
捐贈
What would you check before you donate items after a local emergency?
Before I donate, I would check the organizers' current requests. Sending useful items matters more than clearing out things nobody needs.
捐贈前，我會先看主辦方目前需要什麼。有用的物資，比把沒人需要的東西清出去重要。
service
服務
Which local service would be hardest for your household to lose?
A reliable bus service would be hard for us to lose. Several family members depend on it for work and appointments.
可靠的公車服務，對我們家很重要。家裡好幾個人上班、赴約都要靠它。
access
使用
What could improve access to a public library?
Longer weekend hours could improve access for people who work late. Step-free entrances would help people who cannot use stairs.
延長週末開放時間，能讓晚下班的人更方便使用圖書館。無階梯入口，也能幫助不方便爬樓梯的人。
available
可用
What would you do if the school study room was never available when you needed it?
I would ask the office when the room is usually available. If it is always full, I could suggest a sign-up sheet so more students get a turn.
我會問學校辦公室，自習室通常什麼時候可用。如果總是客滿，可以建議用登記表，讓更多同學輪得到。
fair
公平
How would you make the use of the school basketball courts fair at lunchtime?
A fair system would let classes take turns on different days. The schedule should be posted so nobody feels that older students always get the best times.
公平的做法是讓各班在不同天輪流使用。時間表要公布出來，大家才不會覺得學長姐總是占到最好的時段。
equal
平等
How could a teacher give quieter students an equal chance to share ideas in class?
Giving everyone equal speaking time is a good start, but some students need other ways to contribute. Written comments or small groups could help quieter classmates share their ideas.
給每個人平等的發言時間是好的開始，但有些人需要別的表達方式。用寫的或分小組，能幫助比較安靜的同學分享想法。
participate
參加
What would make you more willing to participate in a class meeting?
I would participate more if we knew the topics beforehand. Knowing that my ideas could really change something would make the meeting worthwhile.
如果事先知道要討論什麼，我會更願意參加。知道自己的意見真的能改變什麼，開班會才值得。
diversity
多樣性
How could a neighbourhood event reflect the diversity of its residents?
The event could reflect diversity through different foods, languages, and activities. Residents should help shape it rather than only be invited to watch.
活動可以透過食物、語言和活動呈現多樣性。居民也應該一起規劃，不只是受邀來看。
safety
安全
What small change could improve safety near a school?
Clearer crossings could improve safety near the school. I would ask families and crossing guards where they see the most confusion.
更清楚的穿越標示，能改善學校附近的安全。我會先問家長和導護，哪裡最容易混亂。
traffic
交通
How could traffic around your school be made safer in the morning?
In the morning, traffic near my school gets very busy when parents stop to drop off their kids. A drop-off zone a little farther away would keep the crossing clearer.
早上家長停車送小孩，學校附近的交通就很混亂。如果在稍遠的地方設接送區，路口就不會那麼擠。
housing
住宅
If many new apartments were built near your home, what would your neighbourhood need?
New housing would bring more families, so we would need more parks and a bigger school. Without them, the area could feel crowded and stressful.
新住宅會帶來更多家庭，所以需要更多公園和更大的學校。不然這一帶可能會變得擁擠又讓人煩躁。
facility
設施
Which shared facility would make your neighbourhood more welcoming?
A small community facility with toilets and seating would help. People could meet there without needing to buy something first.
有廁所和座位的小型公共設施，會很有幫助。大家能在那裡碰面，不必先買東西。
complaint
投訴
How would you write an effective complaint about a repeated local problem?
My complaint would describe the location, dates, and practical impact. I would ask for a specific response rather than simply express anger.
我會在投訴裡寫清楚地點、日期和實際影響。提出具體的回應要求，不只是發洩生氣。
